title: Is there a genuine gap in CI/CD regression testing for quantum software? A primary-source-verified prior-art study
description: A prior-art investigation into whether an open-source, pytest-native, cross-SDK regression/equivalence-testing infrastructure for quantum software exists. Fourteen claims are checked against primary sources, twenty-two prior-art systems are inspected, and the original hypothesis is narrowed in public. Companion tool: pytest-qequiv. Rendered at https://quantum.sadeqi.me/research
